findings.title: Binance Grapples With 'Security Incident' That May Cause $6.3 Billion in Losses
findings.summary_md: The New York Times reported on October 29, 2026 that Binance was grappling with a security incident that could involve roughly $6.3 billion in losses. Binance suspended withdrawals as blockchain partners worked to freeze affected assets.

findings.title: Binance pauses withdrawals as hackers suspected of stealing billions in crypto
findings.summary_md: TechCrunch covered the incident on October 29, 2026, noting Binance temporarily suspended withdrawals across multiple networks following a suspected hack affecting billions in cryptocurrency.

findings.title: Binance freezes billions in cryptocurrency after massive hack
findings.summary_md: The Washington Post reported on October 29, 2026 that Binance said about $6.3 billion in user funds had been affected and that roughly $3 billion had been frozen through on-chain actions by blockchain partners.
